profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a proven software professional with experience in biotech writing instrument control software as well as web applications and services. I've worked using C#, Typescript and Javascript as my main languages while using frameworks such as .NET, Angular and WPF. I have experience developing mainstream products and internal tools for gene sequencing, DNA synthesis and warehouse management.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Software team lead for internal oligonucleotide synthesizer, intended to replace all reliance on outside vendors to reduce costs
●	Designed and developed instrument control software for oligonucleotide synthesizer, including motor control and fluidics control
●	Improved testability by adding simulation and specialized recipe running tools
●	Reduced external orders by 50-75%, achieving similar or better-quality oligonucleotides
●	Developed instrument control software using C#, .NET, WPF and Django
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · C# · WPF · Django REST Framework · Python (Programming Language) · XAML

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Designed and developed software for internal tools and inventory management
●	Developed mobile application for warehouse management and barcode scanning systems
●	Developed features and maintained NuVasive Global website for inventory management, surgeon orders and sales
●	Used C#, TypeScript, .NET Core, Angular, Azure Dev Ops, SQL
positions.insights: Skills: C# · TypeScript · Angular · Software Design · Web Engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, developed and maintained software for various genetic sequencing products. These products include the HiSeq, NovaSeq, and NextSeq systems. Worked in cross-functional engineering teams to deliver high-performant and maintainable instrument control software. Worked in an agile, scrum-based environment utilizing C#, .NET and .NET framework, WPF, XAML, and Angular to build software.

positions.title: Systems/Software Engineer Intern, High Throughput Team
positions.description: As an intern on the High Throughput Team, I maintain and help develop new features for the HiSeq machines, Illumina's flagship gene sequencing machine. I work in a fast-paced AGILE development environment, working on bugs and feature development for multiple releases using C# and the .NET framework. I heavily utilize my knowledge of interprocess communication and parallel programming.

positions.title: ITS Help Desk Tech
positions.description: At the University of San Diego's ITS Help Desk, I troubleshoot and assist with customer's technical issues. Customers include university students, faculty and staff. I utilize my knowledge about computer hardware and software to provide excellent service in computer diagnosis and repair. I have also shadowed full-time desktop technicians to gain advanced technical knowledge and expand my responsibilities.

positions.title: Research Assistant, Kremlin Parallel Profiling Tool
positions.description:
As a research assistant I assisted Dr. Saturnino Garcia in testing and expanding the scope of Kremlin, a profiling tool for parallel programming. My work included writing test cases to detect parallelism in recursive calls in C/C++. Additionally, I extended Kremlin's capabilities by adding an OpenCL planning tool to aid programmers in turning a serial program into a parallel program using OpenCL. In doing so, I learned about parallel programming and how to analyze programs for parallelism. I also gained some basic knowledge of the OpenCL framework.

This work was used for both my senior project for the Computer Science Program, as well as my senior thesis for the Honors Program at the University of San Diego.
